Organisations and businesses are still scrambling to update their systems after cyber-security flaws were revealed in a widely-used programming language, PHP. The Lakers cut Dalton Knecht and kept Bronny James, leaving critics to question whether the final roster spot was wasted. The central question sounds simple. Is a bench spot wasted on a player who rarely plays? The honest answer truly depends on money, fit, development, and what a team needs most over a long season. The Lakers started Monday with 16 players and needed 15 by 5 p.m. Eastern. They waived former first-round pick Dalton Knecht to meet the limit. Bronny James kept his roster spot after the cut. Cuts like this are rarely simple. Teams weigh money, fit, and long-term potential all at once. A roster spot at the end of the bench carries far more thought than most fans ever realize.

BBC Sport's Ask Me Anything team explains what the rules are regarding yellow card suspensions in this season's Champions League Players will receive a one-match ban should they receive four yellow cards before the semi-finals of the Champions League. This rule runs from the start of the league phase until the end of the quarter-finals. After then, all yellow cards are wiped out and players cannot be suspended for multiple yellow cards. During the opening three rounds of Champions League, 16 players received two yellow cards, meaning they are now two cautions away from a one-match ban.

Can Green Bay win another game with just four interior defensive linemen? Detroit will be a big test Most NFL teams still match their defensive personnel to what opposing offenses throw out there, and the Green Bay Packers are no different. In general, defenses want to play as many cornerbacks and nickelbacks as the opposing offense has receivers. So when offenses are in 11 personnel (three receivers, one back and one tight end) sets, defenses tend to play Nickel — which allows for a slot defender to "match" a slot receiver on the field. So far in 2026, the Packers have played 291 of their 292 snaps when they've faced 11 personnel offenses in Nickel (or Dime) sets — 99.7 percent.

Everyday runners are being given the chance to compete alongside elite athletes in the first World Treadmill Championship, a new global 5km competition. For decades, treadmill running has been viewed as little more than a training tool for outdoor runners. But that could be about to change, with the launch of the World Treadmill Championship. In this new World Athletics-sanctioned competition, runners around the world log 5km on a treadmill and compete for a prize pool of $100,000 and the title of world champion. Once the world's largest producer of mink pelts, the nation's industry has declined in recent years. Mink farming will end in Denmark by August 2029 after the government decided to drop plans to pursue an exemption to an EU-wide ban on the practice. Denmark was once the largest producer of mink fur in the world, but the industry has declined due to global bans on fur farming, a decline in the fur trade and an earlier outbreak of a Covid strain in the nation's mink population. The ban is due to come into effect on 7 August next year, and is followed by a two-year transition period to phase out the practice.

Birds' compact nervous system seems to help them handle tasks very quickly. But avian brains that don’t have a neocortex, so it wasn’t obvious how they made similar decisions. “This was the big question,” said Andreas Nieder, a neurobiologist at the University of Tübingen. “How [would] a differently organized avian brain encode decisions?” To find out, Nieder and his colleague Philipp Schmidbauer put two carrion crows through the same task the monkeys faced, recording their brain activity along the way. The crows solved the task the same way primates do, using the same mathematical logic despite having a very different brain structure. And they did it two times faster.

The ICC has confirmed dates for the LA 2028 Olympic cricket qualifiers. The LA 2028 Olympic cricket qualifiers will be held in January and February 2028. Cricket's return to the Olympic Games has moved a step closer, but the road to Los Angeles has also changed in a few important ways. The ICC has confirmed that the men's and women's qualifiers for the LA 2028 Olympics will be played in January and February 2028, and it has also revised how the final automatic women's place will be awarded. According to Cricinfo, the ICC had originally pencilled in 2027 for the qualifying events, but they have now been moved to early 2028, which leaves less than six months before the start of the LA28 Games.

SALT LAKE CITY (AP) — New Orleans starting center Yves Missi injured his left leg in the second quarter of the Pelicans game against the Utah Jazz Friday night and had to be helped to the locker room.With 6:30 left in the second quarter, Zion Williamson's driving shot was blocked by Jaxson Hayes and then Williamson fell into Missi's leg. Evangel junior Aiden Carter is a versatile leader whose impact on the Eagles goes far beyond his stats. Against Byrd on Friday (Oct. 23) night, Carter was the deep man on kickoffs, made several outstanding receptions from freshman quarterback Briggs Berlin and picked off a pass late in the first half to stop a potential Byrd scoring drive.
